headline: Samsung job posting seeks AMS verification for converter, LDO, and PMIC designs
fact: A Samsung careers posting in Bengaluru seeks an AMS verification engineer to create behavioral real-number models for converters and LDOs and work on PMIC verification using UVM, assertions, and automation. This is evidence of a public hiring mandate and its requested scope, not proof that every listed technique was already deployed on a shipped design.

sources.title: Samsung Careers: AMS Verification Engineer
sources.summary: Official Samsung requisition R119757, posted August 20, 2026, describes behavioral real-number modeling for converters and LDOs plus PMIC, UVM, assertion, and automation responsibilities.
